[4:11PM] #OjoduBerger #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is currently free-flowing from Otedola inward Opic Bus Stop in both directions. Movement from Isheri-Olowora through River Valley remains smooth, though vehicles are moving slowly between the Rainoil filling station and Kosoko Bus Stop due to ongoing commercial activities in the area. Traffic along Ogunnusi Road, from VIS to CLAM, is moving smoothly; however, connecting traffic at Omole Junction experiences a slow but steady flow as a result of traffic alternation. Beyond the Omole intersection through to Excellence Hotel, vehicular movement is smooth.

Within Ogba, traffic along Caterpillar Road is moving at a fast pace, while connections through Odo Eran and Wempco Road remain unhindered. In the opposite direction, traffic from Wempco through Odo Eran, Ogba, Excellence Hotel, and Omole Junction is moving smoothly, with only slight delays caused by alternation. Similarly, vehicular movement along Ogunnusi Road, VIS, River Valley, and through to Isheri-Olowora remains seamless. There are currently no impediments within these areas, and our officials are strategically positioned to ensure continuous flow.

#FollowLASTMA
